census_join.note: Confirmed = the census flagged this function AND execution found a constant term in it. Refuted = flagged, exercised, every measured term varied. Unmeasured = flagged but the population never drove it hard enough to answer -- not a pass. The refuted count is the census's false-positive load measured directly, which is why its rate was only ever an upper bound on the defect rate.
